## Global invariant investigation

Using the exact two-state affine transfer, the script tests ULC in s with
ambient degree N=word length+1 separately for f, g and F=yf+g, and tests
adjacent minors in (s,j). All words of length≤10 were enumerated. The
individual-state ULC hypotheses fail, for example g on AAAB has row triple
[2,11,32] at s=1,j=2 and scaled gap −42. Source-word scans are kept separate
because these arbitrary words are not automatically source central words.

For actual sources through denominator 45, the TP2 candidate fails already
for 8/9. Its ambient entries C(1,6), C(2,6), C(1,7), C(2,7) are
[12,464,8,296], with determinant −160. No pinned three-point inequality is
reversed by this four-position minor.

The inherited exact Pell formulas yield a universal expression. On path
replicate(k+j,true), with j≥4, the determinant formed from raw positions
(k+2,j),(k+3,j),(k+1,j+1),(k+2,j+1) is

    32[(k+2)³−j((k+2)²−(k+2)−1)−2].

For k=0 it equals 32(6−j), strictly negative for every j≥7. All four
positions are in the actual source polygon. In ambient coordinates this is
C(1,j)C(2,j+1)−C(2,j)C(1,j+1). The universal formula and its exact source
and ambient interpretation are checked in MarkovShearObstructionB5 if listed
as successfully validated in the final manifest.

The palindrome scan tested 8,189 words of length≤22, retaining coefficient
zeros. Neither individual-state nor terminal-sum ambient ULC failed in its
8,860,294 recorded checks. This suggests a stronger palindrome-specific
induction hypothesis but proves none. Palindromic gas words already have a
checked sum-of-squares representation in MarkovSquares28b1; that inherited
result is not rediscovered or credited as new here.

A direct form in the newer ambient coordinates is useful for that proposed
induction. Both affine transfer matrices share

    K(x) = [[1+x,−x],[−x,x]],
    K T_A = [[xy,0],[0,x]],
    K T_B = [[y+xy²,xy],[xy,x]].

For Q_w(p,q)=(p,q)K T_w(p,q)^T, the exact sandwich identity is
Q_(r w r)(p,q)=Q_w(T_r(p,q)^T). Its central cases are

    Q_empty=p²+x(q−p)²,
    Q_A=x(yp²+q²),
    Q_B=yp²+x(yp+q)².

The source seed (p,q)=(x(1+y),1+x(1+y)) satisfies Q_w=xF_w.
MarkovAmbientFormB5 checks these identities over every commutative ring and
connects the seed expression to every source path without division by x.
These identities alone do not establish log-concavity or a preserved
coefficient inequality. They are a direct-coordinate form of the inherited
square structure, not a claimed new general sum-of-squares theorem.

The mixed term needed to combine the two state rows is a distinct obligation.
At ambient degree N, put A=(s+2)(N−s), B=(s+1)(N−s−1),
f_k=[x^(s+k)y^(j−1)]f (zero if j=0), g_k=[x^(s+k)y^j]g.
The terminal gap decomposes exactly as

    B(f_1+g_1)²−A(f_0+g_0)(f_2+g_2)
      =(B f_1²−A f_0 f_2)+(B g_1²−A g_0 g_2)
        +2B f_1g_1−A(f_0g_2+g_0f_2).

Even for palindromes the mixed term alone need not be nonnegative: word
ABBBBBBBBBA, s=1,j=9 has f=[0,10,524], g=[4,170,3692] and mixed gap
−1168. The total gap remains nonnegative in the tested cases. This arbitrary
palindrome is not silently identified with a source word. All-source mixed
nonnegativity is a separate candidate, still unproved. The exact tests and
their bounds are in synchrony.json and source-mixed-stress.json.

The final stress completed all 84 selected reduced fractions, with denominator
at most 120, testing 821960 triples for each of the two component gaps, the
mixed gap and the terminal gap. No failure occurred. Inputs and seed are saved;
these selected inputs are not exhaustive rational coverage. The palindrome

# Uniform horizontal residual support

Machine-authored request ea4238fc86ab42dca04c21467d7fa66c. Full pinned Conjecture63 remains unresolved. Build/replay status is recorded separately; this prose is not an admission receipt.

Let x be the horizontal coefficient variable, Y the rescaled row variable, and h=1+x. For a product M of the inherited integral horizontal matrices, put F=M.a+M.c and H=M.b+M.d-M.a-M.c. Appending letters has the following exact positive recurrence, starting from (F,H)=(1,0):

    A: F'=Y(hF+xH), H'=F+H.
    B: F'=Y(h²F+x(x+2)H)+Y²(h³F+xh²H),
       H'=x(F+H)+Y(h²F+xhH).

This follows by a ring identity from the actual K matrices, not from interpolation. If a is the number of B letters, every nonzero row j of both states has nonnegative coefficients, no internal gaps in positive support, and upper endpoint j+a. The proof uses shifted support bounds, addition at a common endpoint, multiplication by x, and multiplication by x+1 or x+2. Each summand in the displayed recurrence has the same endpoint after accounting for its Y shift. Zero rows remain allowed.

For sourceWord28 path, the second state is exactly the inherited hresidualM511, by hresidual_diffM511, and the B count is the source numerator a. The proof therefore gives uniform interval support for every horizontal residual row, without a denominator or row cutoff. It does not assert log-concavity. An adjacent-to-CrossLC equivalence and a source raw transfer for 2j+1<=b are being checked separately. For larger j, canceling an extra binomial smoothing factor backwards would still be invalid.

The expanded alphabet admits an additional atomic operation, with M=hF+xH:

    A: (F,H) -> (Y M,F+H),
    C: (F,H) -> (F+Y h M,M),
    B=A followed by C.

The C operation has a lower-degree F term. Its support proof must not assume identical endpoints for every summand. The checked strengthened invariant records outer-degree bounds, a zero F row at index zero, and attained top coefficients in every remaining row. These conditions supply the missing endpoint for that lower-degree term. Starting after A, both operations preserve the invariant.

For the vertical integral matrices, take F=M.c+M.d and H=M.a+M.b-M.c-M.d. Prepending the original A acts by C above, while prepending the original B acts by A then C. Every source word ends in B, so right-to-left induction starts in the checked invariant. Consequently every vertical residual row i also has nonnegative interval support, ending at i+b whenever nonzero. No claim of arbitrary signed-matrix positivity is involved.

MarkovHorizontalIntervalMEA423 compiles the adjacent-to-CrossLC equivalence and the raw horizontal transfer under 2j+1<=b. MarkovVerticalIntervalMEA423 supplies the vertical counterparts under 2i+1<=a. The first six modules passed isolated kernel replay and permitted-axiom closure inspection (41 theorem closures). The later validation manifest is authoritative.

Exact finite checks passed 1,064,166 coefficients in the source scaling identity and 639,351 horizontal residual adjacent comparisons across all 449 reduced fractions with b<=38, retaining 91,614 zeros. The mixed same-row F/H adjacent condition had no failure in this scan. None of these finite observations is a proof.

The enlarged palindrome family A B A^n B B fails residual LC: n=24 gives row 4, coefficients at exponents 1,2,3 equal to 4,56,799, with 56²<4*799. This is an experimental non-source obstruction, not a refutation of Conjecture63. Thus palindromicity and the proved interval-support invariant alone cannot justify extending LC to every word.

The independent vertical recurrence implementation passed 548,836 coefficients in the source scaling identity and 443,294 residual adjacent comparisons across all 323 reduced fractions with b<=32, retaining 48,182 zeros. Its same-row F/H mixed comparison also had no failure. These are finite experiments and the full mixed or residual LC claims remain unproved.

MarkovResidualEndpointsMEA423 proves that either coordinate residual is zero exactly when its row index exceeds d=a+b-1. For a nonzero horizontal row j its degree is a+j; for a nonzero vertical row i its degree is b+i. It also proves the high-index identities

    R_horizontal,j=(1+x)^(2j+1-b) [v^j]P, when b<=2j+1,
    R_vertical,i=(1+x)^(2i+1-a) [u^i]P, when a<=2i+1.

These are identities in the direction opposite the low-index transfer. Log-concavity of their left side does not justify cancellation of the extra smoothing factor. No new unconditional raw LC region is claimed in this run. The exact pinned root residual remains MarkovResidualMF8, unchanged and unproved.

MarkovResidualLeadingMEA423 derives the exact top coefficients by extracting the common highest degree in the cleared source identity. They are choose(d,d-j)=choose(d,j) horizontally and choose(d,i) vertically. Thus the endpoint degree is attained with the original top-diagonal binomial coefficient, not an experimentally fitted value.

The further mixed-term probe tested 366,288 comparisons on 127 actual source states through b=20. /-! Machine-authored operational checker. Replay the union of this run's
constants over only its inherited import boundary. No new-module constants
are admitted by import before replay. This is not a mathematical theorem. -/
open Lean
unsafe def replayIsolatedM553 (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  initSearchPath (← findSysroot)
  let names := args.map String.toName
  let mut imports : Array Import := #[]
  let mut newConstants := {}
  for name in names do
    let mFile ← findOLean name
    let mut fnames := #[mFile]
    let sFile := OLeanLevel.server.adjustFileName mFile
    if (← sFile.pathExists) then
      fnames := fnames.push sFile
      let pFile := OLeanLevel.private.adjustFileName mFile
      if (← pFile.pathExists) then fnames := fnames.push pFile
    let parts ← readModuleDataParts fnames
    if h : parts.size = 0 then throw <| IO.userError "empty module data" else
    let (mod, _) := parts[0]
    for imp in mod.imports do
      if !names.contains imp.module && !imports.any (fun i => i.module == imp.module) then
        imports := imports.push imp
    for n in parts[parts.size-1].1.constNames, ci in parts[parts.size-1].1.constants do
      newConstants := newConstants.insert n ci
    IO.println s!"collected {name}"
  let (_, s) ← importModulesCore imports |>.run
  let env ← finalizeImport s imports {} 0 false false (isModule := true)
  IO.println s!"replay union of {names.length} modules over {imports.size} inherited imports"
  let mut audited := 0
  for (n, ci) in newConstants.toList do
    if n.toString.startsWith "MathGKM.Markov." && n.toString.endsWith "M553" then
      if (env.find? n).isSome then
        throw <| IO.userError s!"selected mathematical constant already imported: {n}"
      if ci.isUnsafe || ci.isPartial then
        throw <| IO.userError s!"unsafe or partial mathematical constant: {n}"
      audited := audited + 1
  IO.println s!"isolation checked for {audited} mathematical constants"
  let env' ← env.replay newConstants
  env'.freeRegions
  IO.println "replay union passed"

/- Run the unchanged kernel replay body on a joined Lean task with the requested thread stack. -/
unsafe def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let t ← IO.asTask (replayIsolatedM553 args)
  IO.ofExcept t.get

# Positive ambient transfer and the Pell kernel

Machine-authored request 5c90b5063976426b9c5577badcc55c00. No novelty claim.

by the final validation manifest, not by the existence of a draft file.

## Exact all-source change of exponents

Set u=x, v=xy. For the source a/b let c be its inherited exact central A/B
word (length b-2, B-count a-1). The new denominator-free gauge calculation
proves

    P_(a/b)(x,xy) = x^a F_c(x,y),
    F_c = (y,1) T_c (x(1+y), 1+x(1+y))^T,
    T_A = [[xy,x],[xy,1+x]],
    T_B = [[y+xy(1+y),x(1+y)],
           [2y+xy(1+y),1+x(1+y)]] .

Both transfers are linear in x with nonnegative coefficients. Their linear
parts are H and (1+y)H, where H=[[y,1],[y,1]] and H^2=(1+y)H.
The constant parts are D_A=[[0,0],[0,1]] and D_B=[[y,0],[2y,1]].
This is an exact polynomial identity at x=0 as well: the proof multiplies
through the diagonal gauge and cancels only the nonzero polynomial X, never
a real value or a raw coefficient.

For s=i+j-a >=0 the literal coefficient identity is

    A(i,j) = [x^s y^j] F_c.

With i,j natural and i+j=a+s, the polygon condition is exactly

    s <= b-1,  (b-a)j <= b s.

The natural original index also retains j<=a+s. The three original
directions become respectively (1,0), (1,1), and (0,1) in (s,j). In
particular, a horizontal-only argument in these new variables does NOT
establish the original vertical or diagonal clauses.

## A broader sufficient horizontal target

For an arbitrary A/B word w let N=length(w)+1 and C_w(s,j)=[x^s y^j]F_w.
The proposed assertion is

    (s+2)(N-s) C_w(s,j) C_w(s+2,j)
       <= (s+1)(N-s-1) C_w(s+1,j)^2,   s+2<=N.

The new reduction connects this explicitly unproved all-word assertion to
the actual source ambient bound and hence raw horizontal inequalities.
It does not assume arbitrary-word vertical or diagonal log-concavity.

The exact enumeration extends earlier no-adjacent-C experiments to the
ambient bound: 28,656 gas cores of length 1 through 21, beginning and ending
in A and with no CC, give 4,415,699 nontrivial horizontal triples without
failure. Every such core is expand(w)A for a unique original A/B word w.
Zero endpoint products are omitted only from the nontrivial count; they
satisfy the tested inequality because all coefficients and both scalar
weights in range are nonnegative. This is finite evidence, not a proof.

## Exact Pell generating kernel

For c=B^(a-1), write Q_a=F_c and Q_0=1. The new formal recurrence is

    Q_1=1+x(1+y)^2,
    Q_(a+2)=(1+y+x(1+y)^2)Q_(a+1)-y Q_a.

As an ordinary formal power series in z, it gives the checked equation

    [(1-z)(1-yz)-xz(1+y)^2] sum_(a>=0) Q_a z^a = 1-yz.

The exact source coefficient bridge retains every natural i,j,s satisfying
i+j=a+s. This supplies the source interpretation of the ambient kernel.
The recurrence also gives the checked Cassini identity

    Q_a Q_(a+2)-Q_(a+1)^2 = x y^(a+1)(1+y)^2.

Its sign concerns the FAMILY index a, not any pinned coefficient direction.
It must not be used as a coefficient log-concavity assertion.

Writing K_s(z)=sum_(a>=0) [x^s]Q_a z^a, the extracted recurrence is

    (1-z)(1-yz) K_(s+1) = z(1+y)^2 K_s,
    (1-z) K_0 = 1.

MarkovAmbientSlices5c90 proves these equations over every commutative ring,
then proves by induction the denominator-cleared form of

    sum_(a>=s) [x^s]Q_a z^a
      = z^s(1+y)^(2s)/[(1-z)^(s+1)(1-yz)^s].

The extracted identity is therefore checked as an ordinary formal-power-series
equation, including s=0, with no division or convergence assumption. Its
positive binomial expansion is compatible with the inherited exact binomial
sums. None of these identities proves the aggregate coefficient inequality;
global horizontal aggregation remains open.

## A source obstruction to a tempting shortcut

For c=A (actual source 1/3), the new exact identity is

    F_A(x,y)=1+2x(1+y)+x^2(1+y)^3.

At y=1 this is 1+4x+8x^2, strictly positive for every real x and of degree
two. Thus even the sheared total-degree polynomial need not be real-rooted.
The exact source identity and strict positivity are proved in Lean; the
Sturm probe independently records zero real roots. This rules out blanket
real-rootedness of F_w(x,y) at positive y. It does not refute either the
ambient coefficient bound or the published raw inequalities. In particular,
evaluating y=1 sums many coefficient rows, whereas the horizontal target
extracts one fixed y coefficient.

## A candidate on the entire source family

Write A(i,j) for the literal source coefficient at reduced a/b, and put
N=b-1 and s=i+j-a. Polygon membership implies 0<=s and s+2<=N for a
horizontal triple. The proposed stronger inequality is

    (s+2)(N-s) A(i,j) A(i+2,j)
      <= (s+1)(N-s-1) A(i+1,j)^2.

Equivalently, the horizontal coefficients divided by choose(N,s) should be
log-concave, with s changing along the row. This normalization is an auxiliary
sufficient condition, NOT the pinned target. The two scalar factors differ
by N+1=b. Nonnegative source coefficients and positive right scalar therefore
give the original raw inequality. MarkovAmbient77c2 proves this implication
with the actual polygon hypotheses and raw coefficients. AmbientHorizontal77
is a Prop definition and is not asserted as a theorem.

This extends the preceding Pell candidate from ambient a for a/(a+1) to
ambient b-1 for every source. It does not replace the other two directions.

## Unconditional first-row calculation

For c_k=[x^k](1+x)^n(A+Bx), A,B>=0, put N=n+2. The exact identity is

    c_k / choose(N,k+1)
      = (k+1)[A(n+1-k)+Bk] / ((n+2)(n+1)), 0<=k<=n+1.

The numerator has shape f(s)=s(C+Ds). At consecutive indices,

    f(s+1)^2-f(s)f(s+2)
      = [C+D(s+1)]^2 + D^2 s(s+2).

This is nonnegative for s>=0, including decreasing affine factors and zero
cases. The generic proof and binomial normalization identities are checked
in MarkovRowNormalization77c2. The source first-row identity already proved
in MarkovHorizontalLCB46 is

    [v]P_(a/b)=u^a(1+u)^(b-3)[(3a-1)+(a+b-1)u].

The new exact source bridge gives the ambient normalized inequality on j=1
for every path. Polynomial mapping and shifting are checked explicitly.
MarkovAmbientScaling77c2 converts normalized comparisons to their literal
integer-scaled form using the exact binomial ratio identity, without assuming
that the source coefficients are nonzero. Polygon membership on j=1 forces
i>=a, so this covers every admissible horizontal triple in that row.

## Entire numerator-one family

For the source 1/b, set N=b-1 and s=i+j-1. The exact Fibonacci formula and
the elementary binomial subset identity give

    A(i,j)/choose(N,s)
      = choose(s,j) choose(s+1,j)/choose(N,j), i>=1.

For fixed j each numerator factor is log-concave as its upper argument
increases. Their product is log-concave, so the stronger ambient inequality
holds for the entire numerator-one horizontal family. The binomial identity,
normalization, inequality and conversion back to integer scalars are checked
in MarkovFibonacciAmbient77c2. MarkovAmbientSourceBounds77c2 supplies the exact
source and polygon transports when its successful receipts are listed in the
validation manifest. No statement about general interior rows follows.

## Experiments and a refinement distinction

ambient-source.json records 824,919 raw horizontal tests on all reduced
interior rationals of denominator <=50, with no ambient failure. The 342,074
coefficientwise tests using the earlier common C-site parameter, restricted
to denominator <=24, DO have a failure. At source 2/7, row j=1, i=5,6,7,
the deformed coefficients are experimentally

    64+4t, 36+t, 8.

The scaled gap is 336-24t+5t^2. Its coefficient of t is negative (-24),
but its value is positive for every real t, since

    5(336-24t+5t^2)=(5t-12)^2+1536.

At the actual source t=1 the raw triple is [68,37,8]; its raw gap is 825 and

different from the inherited Pell charge q. Failure of one coefficientwise
refinement does not refute either unrefined candidate.

## Pell generating-function route retained as a derivation

For inherited H(a,j,s,q)=choose(a-q,s)choose(s+q-1,q)choose(2s,j-q),
s>=1, negative-binomial expansions give the formal generating identity

## A raw model with the scaling made explicit

Write x=u, y=v, h=1+x. The top row (Q,P) of the raw positive matrix word starts at (1,0). Appending the expanded atomic letters has the exact updates

    A: (Q,P) -> (y(Q+xP), Q+hP),
    C: (Q,P) -> ((1+y)Q+xyP, Q+xP),
    B = A followed by C.

MarkovRawPrefixM10D identifies this pair with the inherited gas matrix product, then identifies its P component on every expanded sourceWord28 path with the protected raw numerator (frame path).mid.p. This is an ordinary polynomial identity, with no factorial or coefficient-dependent normalization.

After the first A, let k be the number of additional original A/B letters, and let (F,H) be the inherited positive horizontal residual pair. The integral substitution phi sends y to yh² and fixes x. MarkovRawConjugacyM10D and MarkovWordConjugacyM10D prove

    phi(Q)=h^(k+1) F,     phi(P)=h^k H.

The proof is preserved separately by atomic A and C, using only polynomial ring identities. Induction covers every original Boolean tail w after the first A, with k=length(w); there is no moment, denominator, or word-length cutoff. At row j it yields

    h^(2j) [y^j]P = h^k [y^j]H.

For an arbitrary word H denotes the positive hdiff state. Its identification with the separately defined hresidualM511 is asserted only for actual source words, where the inherited hresidual_diffM511 theorem applies.

For 2j<=k this gives raw = h^(k-2j) residual. For k<=2j it gives residual = h^(2j-k) raw. Both directions of polynomial factorization are proved, including equality at the dividing index. These identities do not allow cancellation of log-concavity. In particular the high-index raw inequalities remain required.

MarkovSourceConjugacyM10D specializes the integral word identity to every actual source path and row, with k=b-1 and H_j exactly hresidualM511. This supplies a direct integral proof of the inherited cleared source identity. It does not remove any region from the exact residual InteriorCore63MF8.

## Why requiring both residual states to be LC at every source prefix fails

For every n>=0, after the original word A^(n+2) B A, the second row of the auxiliary F state is exactly

    2x+5x²+(n+4)x³.

MarkovPrefixObstructionM10D proves this from the actual hK word recurrence, starting with the first two row identities along A runs. For every n>=9 its consecutive coefficients satisfy 25<2(n+4).

MarkovSourcePrefixM10D proves that this word is the prefix of length n+4 of the actual source at 2/(2n+5), whose path is false^(n+1) followed by true. Thus the obstruction occurs on an unbounded family of actual source prefixes. It concerns an auxiliary F state, not the final residual H or the protected raw source polynomial. At n=9 the ambient source is 2/23 and the failing F triple is [2,5,13].

## A polygon-valid raw failure at a source prefix is still not a root refutation

Let W=A B B B B B A B B. It is the length-nine prefix of the source word for 11/13, path [true,true,true,true,true,false]. Its counts are a=7,b=9. The raw matrix b-entry has coefficients

    A(4,4)=10, A(5,3)=14, A(6,2)=20.

All three positions satisfy InPolygon 7 9, but 14²=196<200=10*20. MarkovRawPrefixM10D proves the exact matrix/word identity, the prefix provenance, all three coefficients, all polygon guards, and the reversed inequality.

Crucially, it also proves W is not sourceWord28 path for any path. At prefix length six W has five B letters, while the source mechanical-prefix theorem at 7/9 forces floor(7*6/9)=4. This is a formal source-family exclusion, not an omitted bridge.

MarkovPrefixScopeM10D proves the contrasting actual 7/9 source triple is [4,12,20], with all polygon guards and 4*20<=12². In the enclosing actual 11/13 source all three positions have coefficient zero and lie below its polygon. Neither source polynomial refutes Conjecture63. The new failure rules out enlarging the target to all raw prefixes of source words even if one keeps the count-based polygon guards.

## Experiments and limits

The grouped recurrence probe covered 2,397 source-prefix states through denominator 30. Same-row synchronization, weighted synchronization, auxiliary F-row LC, and one proposed grouped C comparison all had failures. H-row LC had none in this finite probe. The raw-prefix probe covered 4,096 distinct prefixes through denominator 42 and made 8,519,796 coefficient comparisons; it found 257 diagonal failures and no coordinate failure. These are strategy experiments, not universal inequalities.

That initial raw-prefix diagnostic enumerated supported centers. The separate probe_raw_prefix_zero_10d15751.py rerun explicitly retained zero centers and tested every center in the full degree triangle plus a zero boundary layer. It made 11,447,217 comparisons and found the same 257 diagonal failures and no coordinate failure. Its authoritative zero-inclusive result is raw-prefix-zero-experiments.json; the initial program and result are preserved.

A final scope-check rerun made the same comparisons with an explicit assertion that no failing prefix is the completed source word. It passed, recording completed_source_failures=0 in raw-prefix-scope-experiments.json. This remains finite evidence only.

The truncated-row probe tested rows zero through eight on all reduced interior fractions with denominator at most 70 and a recorded deterministic sample up to 400. It checked 31,611 distinct prefixes. Its 2,653,926 adjacent comparisons found no H-prefix, complete-source H, or complete-source F failure. Zero coefficients were retained. Truncation only removes higher y-degrees, which cannot affect lower rows in the positive recurrence. Inputs and code are saved; no proof claim is based on this finite calculation.

The raw horizontal closure-cone probe is a separate strategy experiment; its final result is raw-cone-experiments.json. None of the experimental predicates is silently adopted as a Lean premise.

The latter probe tested 630 enlarged words and 631,476 comparisons. Both raw components' horizontal LC survived, but their same-row, next-Q, and next-P mixed inequalities failed. The grouped B-to-P comparison had no failure. This reinforces the need to control the sum of signed gap contributions, rather than demand every mixed term be nonnegative. It is finite advice only; arbitrary-word horizontal LC remains unproved.

The explicit theorem universal_source_prefix_failureM10D refutes the proposed all-source-prefix WeakLC enlargement itself. Its target is not Conjecture63, and completion remains null.
